text:
Situation: Dulaglutide has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-12-15 and remained listed for 46 months as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 151 units of DULAGLUTIDE 0.75MG/0.5ML 5ML SYR with daily use of 3.4, providing 44 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows dulaglutide listed continuously since 2022-12-15 through 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 44 days. The rule-based best option is purchasing from Eli Lilly and Company, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer initiates purchase order for dulaglutide from Eli Lilly and Company; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer confirms delivery timeline and allocates stock to Corvale East; requires Inventory Manager approval.
3. Buyer monitors FDA shortage list weekly for status changes; requires Pharmacy Director acknowledgment.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending shortage resolution; sourcing from suppliers currently on FDA's shortage list; adjusting clinical protocols without committee review.
